disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码、配置、测试与文档中的硬编码密钥与凭据模式，未发现 API 密钥、云凭据、SSH 私钥、钱包助记词等硬编码值。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code, configuration, tests, and documentation for hardcoded credentials and secret patterns; no API keys, cloud credentials, SSH private keys, wallet mnemonics, or other hardcoded values were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了敏感路径读取面：插件只读写自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件与设置文件（存放于宿主目录下的 dsh-pocket 子目录，权限 600），没有读取宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据等第三方敏感文件的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Audited the sensitive path read surface: the plugin only reads its own generated 8-digit access password file and settings file (stored in the dsh-pocket subdirectory under the host directory, permission 600); there is no code path that reads host credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, or other third-party sensitive files.

checked_items.zh: 核查了凭据批量搜集语义（全盘搜索密钥、云账号枚举命令、钱包资产发现），命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked for credential bulk-gathering semantics (full-disk key search, cloud account enumeration commands, wallet asset discovery); hits: 0.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件（token/token-lan），未读取宿主 .credentials.yaml、SSH 私钥或云凭据。密码文件以 600 权限写入，不随网络流量外发。
evidence.en: The sensitive data read by the plugin is limited to its own generated 8-digit access password file (token/token-lan); it does not read the host's .credentials.yaml, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials. The password file is written with permission 600 and is not sent outbound with network traffic.

checked_items.zh: 核查了插件注册的全部对外文本面：本插件不注册任何供模型调用的工具，只注册设置页签与移动端界面组件，无工具描述文本可投毒。
checked_items.en: Checked all external text surfaces registered by the plugin: this plugin does not register any tools callable by the model; it only registers a settings tab and mobile UI components, so there is no tool description text that could be poisoned.

checked_items.zh: 核查了 README、源码注释、界面文案中是否有指令覆写、伪造系统消息、要求读取凭据等注入措辞，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked README, source code comments, and UI copy for injection wording such as instruction overrides, fake system messages, or requests to read credentials; hits: 0.

checked_items.zh: 全树扫描未发现 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、Claude/Cursor 指令文件、MCP 配置等模型面指令文件。
checked_items.en: Full-tree scan found no model-facing instruction files such as AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, Claude/Cursor instruction files, or MCP configuration.

checked_items.zh: 核查了客户端注入网页的脚本（polyfill、桌面端兼容补丁、警告覆盖层）：均为静态固定脚本，无远程动态内容、无指令性文本。
checked_items.en: Checked scripts injected into the client webpage (polyfill, desktop compatibility patch, warning overlay): all are static fixed scripts; no remote dynamic content, no instructional text.

evidence.zh: 本插件不注册任何模型可调用的工具，无工具描述文本可投毒；设置页与移动端界面文案经语义审查无注入措辞。
evidence.en: This plugin does not register any tools callable by the model, so there is no tool description text that could be poisoned; the settings page and mobile UI copy have been semantically reviewed and contain no injection wording.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何面向模型的工具描述，不存在诱导模型执行安装、改写配置的文本载体。
evidence.en: The plugin has no tool descriptions facing the model; there is no text carrier that could induce the model to execute installation or rewrite configuration.

checked_items.zh: 核查了全部源码中的进程调用（spawn/execFile/execSync）共 5 处：插件自更新（规则 DSH-X03，调用 dsh 命令拉取新版）、自重启（拉起辅助进程重建宿主）、公网隧道（cloudflared 子进程）、WSL 局域网 IP 探测（ipconfig）。逐处确认参数固定或来自宿主自身启动参数，无外部输入拼入命令，用途与声明功能一致，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked all process calls in the source code (spawn/execFile/execSync) — 5 occurrences: plugin self-update (rule DSH-X03, calls the dsh command to pull the latest version), self-restart (spawns helper process to restart the host), public network tunnel (cloudflared child process), WSL LAN IP detection (ipconfig). Each occurrence was verified to have fixed parameters or parameters from the host's own startup arguments; no external input is concatenated into the command; the purpose matches the declared function; deemed benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查了客户端打包产物中的键盘监听（规则 DSH-X05，两处）：都是移动端抽屉按 Escape 键关闭的 UI 逻辑，仅比对按键名，无键盘记录、无剪贴板读取、无凭据接口调用，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked keyboard listeners in the client build artifacts (rule DSH-X05, two occurrences): both are UI logic for closing the mobile drawer on pressing the Escape key; they only compare the key name, with no keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential API calls; deemed benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查了打包产物与测试文件中的高密度转义文本（规则 DSH-X08，两处）：都是中文注释与测试数据被构建工具转成 Unicode 转义，非刻意混淆，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked high-density escaped text in build artifacts and test files (rule DSH-X08, two occurrences): both are Chinese comments and test data that were converted to Unicode escape sequences by the build tool, not intentional obfuscation; deemed benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查了仓库自带的 GitHub Actions 发布流程（规则 DSH-X07）：仅触发 npm 测试与发布，无外联脚本、无凭据读取、无隐蔽下载执行，属常规工程流程，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: Checked the repository's built-in GitHub Actions release workflow (rule DSH-X07): it only triggers npm tests and publishing; no outbound scripts, no credential reading, no covert download-and-execute; it is a routine engineering workflow; deemed benign.

checked_items.zh: 未检出 eval、动态函数构造、Base64 解码即执行等动态执行模式；未检出 cordis 动态包工具调用。
checked_items.en: No dynamic execution patterns detected such as eval, dynamic function construction, or Base64 decode-and-execute; no cordis dynamic package tool calls detected.

checked_items.zh: 未检出安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），依赖均锁定 npm 官方源，无浮动的 git 依赖。
checked_items.en: No install hooks detected (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); all dependencies are locked to the official npm registry; no floating git dependencies.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一条插件插入声明（id: dsh-pocket），全文无任何 JS 执行标量（!!js），loader 不会在宿主进程求值任意代码。
evidence.en: The patch configuration cordis.patch.yml contains only a single plugin insertion declaration (id: dsh-pocket); the entire file has no JS execution scalars (!!js); the loader will not evaluate arbitrary code in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未检出对动态包工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的调用，插件没有让模型在宿主 vm 里跑代码的接口。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package tools (cordis_define/cordis_run type) detected; the plugin has no interface for the model to run code inside the host vm.

evidence.zh: package.json 无任何安装钩子脚本；依赖均来自 npm 官方源并锁定版本范围，无 git 浮动引用；仓库内 CI 工作流仅做测试与发布，无外联下载执行。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hook scripts; all dependencies come from the official npm registry with version ranges locked; no git floating references; the CI workflow in the repository only does testing and publishing, with no outbound download-and-execute.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了 dsh.client 客户端模块并对打包产物做了专项核查：键盘监听仅用于 Escape 关闭抽屉，无剪贴板访问、无凭据 RPC 调用、无可疑外联，属良性 UI 行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a dsh.client client module and a dedicated audit was performed on the build artifacts: the keyboard listener is only for closing the drawer with the Escape key; no clipboard access, no credential RPC calls, no suspicious outbound connections; it is a benign UI behavior.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络外联点：npm registry 版本检查（registry.npmjs.org）、cloudflared 二进制下载（官方 GitHub + 国内镜像加速源）、公网隧道到 Cloudflare 边缘——均为插件声明功能所需，无未声明端点。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network outbound points: npm registry version check (registry.npmjs.org), cloudflared binary download (official GitHub + domestic mirror accelerator), public network tunnel to Cloudflare edge — all are required for the plugin's declared functionality; no undeclared endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 核查了敏感文件读取后编码外发的组合链（读取 → 编码/压缩 → 网络发送），命中 0；插件只处理自己的密码文件，无凭据外发通道。
checked_items.en: Checked for sensitive file read followed by encoding and outbound transmission (read → encode/compress → network send); hits: 0; the plugin only processes its own password file; there is no channel for credential exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 核查了 DNS 隧道、Webhook 回调、AI 端点劫持、代理环境变量劫持等带外通道模式，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Checked for out-of-band channels such as DNS tunneling, Webhook callbacks, AI endpoint hijacking, and proxy environment variable hijacking; hits: 0.

evidence.zh: 插件读取的敏感数据仅限自己生成的 8 位访问密码文件；公网隧道暴露的是用户主动开启的访问入口，密码不随隧道流量外发，未发现凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The sensitive data read by the plugin is limited to its own generated 8-digit access password file; the public network tunnel exposes an access entry that the user actively opens; the password is not sent outbound with the tunnel traffic; no credential exfiltration channel was found.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖仅 qrcode 与 qrcode-terminal（知名稳定库），宿主 SDK 为官方 @deepseek-ai/cordis，无 typosquatting、无与 dsh 生态命名撞车的可疑包。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency list: runtime dependencies are only qrcode and qrcode-terminal (well-known stable libraries); the host SDK is the official @deepseek-ai/cordis; no typosquatting, no suspicious packages that collide with the dsh ecosystem naming.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml：只做插件插入（insert），未触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行，无 disabled 降权、无环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch configuration cordis.patch.yml: it only performs plugin insertion (insert); it does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; there is no disabled downgrade or environment variable downgrade pattern.

checked_items.zh: 未检出对安全事件的抢先监听（prepend），未检出拦截/注入配置改写（inject/intercept）。
checked_items.en: No preemptive listening on security events (prepend) detected; no injection/interception of configuration rewriting (inject/intercept) detected.

checked_items.zh: 发布流程为常规 npm publish（GitHub Actions 触发 release 事件），无安装期远程脚本执行。
checked_items.en: The release workflow is a conventional npm publish (GitHub Actions triggered by the release event); no remote script execution during installation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅含一条 insert 声明，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无 disabled 降权、无环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch configuration contains only a single insert declaration; it does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; there is no disabled downgrade or environment variable downgrade pattern.

evidence.zh: 未检出对工具预执行（tools/pre-execute）或审批请求（approval/request）等安全事件的优先监听，插件不介入审批链，不存在截断可能。
evidence.en: No preemptive listening on security events such as tools/pre-execute or approval/request detected; the plugin does not intervene in the approval chain; there is no possibility of interception.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较，无法比对 manifest 能力声明的突变。
evidence.en: First audit, no baseline version available for comparison; cannot compare the mutation of manifest capability declarations.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入（inject）或拦截（intercept）配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久挂起的路径。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not contain injection (inject) or interception (intercept) configuration; there is no path to add a required service to a security plugin, causing it to hang indefinitely.

checked_items.zh: 核查了插件是否启动网络服务：插件会启动一个反向代理（默认监听 0.0.0.0:3081）把手机流量转发到本机 dsh web——这是插件核心功能（手机访问），已在能力声明与文档中明示。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a network service: the plugin starts a reverse proxy (default listening on 0.0.0.0:3081) to forward mobile traffic to the local dsh web — this is the plugin's core functionality (mobile access), and has been clearly stated in the capability declaration and documentation.

checked_items.zh: 核查了该服务的安全设计：公网入口强制 8 位密码并每次开启自动轮换、登录失败有速率限制（单 IP 5 次/分钟触发锁 60 秒、全局 50 次/分钟锁 30 秒）、开启公网前强制阅读免责声明（服务端校验不可绕过）、WebSocket 同样校验——防护措施与暴露面匹配。
checked_items.en: Checked the security design of this service: the public network entry requires an 8-digit password that is automatically rotated each time it is opened; login attempts are rate-limited (5 times/minute per IP triggers a 60-second lock, 50 times/minute globally triggers a 30-second lock); reading a disclaimer is mandatory before opening the public network (server-side validation, cannot be bypassed); WebSocket also requires authentication — the protection measures match the exposure surface.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本环境无 DG-L4 产物），运行时行为基于静态分析结论。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no DG-L4 artifact available in this environment); runtime behavior is based on static analysis conclusions.

evidence.zh: 插件启动的反向代理属声明功能。相对宿主原生 web 服务，该代理为公网/局域网访问额外加了密码认证、速率限制与免责声明确认，未发现超越声明的无认证暴露面。
evidence.en: The reverse proxy started by the plugin is a declared functionality. Compared to the host's native web service, this proxy adds password authentication, rate limiting, and disclaimer confirmation for public/LAN access; no unauthenticated exposure surface beyond the declaration was found.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：包名、版本、仓库地址与任务卡一致；无 dsh.plugin.json 单独文件，以 package.json 的 dsh 字段声明为准。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: package name, version, and repository URL match the task card; there is no separate dsh.plugin.json file; the declaration in the dsh field of package.json is authoritative.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：预扫 10 条机械命中全部逐条核查并判定为良性功能用法，未检出动态执行、凭据窃取、外联等危险模式。
summary.en: Static scanning completed: all 10 mechanical hits from the pre-scan were individually verified and deemed benign functional usage; no dangerous patterns such as dynamic execution, credential theft, or outbound connections were detected.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：子进程调用（DSH-X03/X07）、网络外联（DSH-X07）、文件写入均与声明功能对应；无安装钩子、无混淆载荷（DSH-X08 为构建工具转义）、无敏感路径读取。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis completed: child process calls (DSH-X03/X07), network outbound connections (DSH-X07), and file writes all correspond to declared functionality; no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads (DSH-X08 is build tool escaping), no sensitive path reads.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：插件无模型工具描述（DSH-X10 命中 0）；客户端注入文本与界面文案经语义审查无注入措辞（DSH-X05 为 Escape 键 UI 逻辑，判定良性）。
summary.en: AI metadata review completed: the plugin has no model tool descriptions (DSH-X10 hits: 0); client-injected text and UI copy have been semantically reviewed and contain no injection wording (DSH-X05 is Escape key UI logic, deemed benign).

summary.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），未做动态验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox artifact (l4-sandbox.json) was provided in this environment; no dynamic verification was performed.

limits.zh: 1) 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物（l4-sandbox.json 不存在），DG-L4 动态验证未执行，运行时行为基于静态分析结论。2) package.json 的 dsh 声明不含显式能力清单字段，插件能力（网络、进程调用、文件写入）由代码实测推断，已在 capability_diff 对账。3) context/manifest.json 所列 43 个文件全部在源码树中可定位，已核查其中全部代码与配置类文件；docs 下的图片资源未逐字节解读（二进制多媒体）。
limits.en: 1) No dynamic sandbox artifact (l4-sandbox.json) was provided in this environment; DG-L4 dynamic verification was not performed; runtime behavior is based on static analysis conclusions. 2) The dsh declaration in package.json does not contain an explicit capability list field; the plugin's capabilities (network, process calls, file writes) are inferred from actual code inspection, and have been reconciled in the capability_diff. 3) All 43 files listed in context/manifest.json are locatable in the source tree; all code and configuration files among them have been audited; image resources under docs were not interpreted byte-by-byte (binary multimedia).
